description: This file contains Makefile macros and shell script functions for automating build configuration, including autoreconf, patching libtool, and handling gettext versioning, specific to the OpenWrt build system.

methods.name: autoconf_bool
methods.description: Generates enable/disable flags based on configuration variables.

methods.name: libtool_remove_files
methods.description: Removes '*.la' files from a specified directory.

methods.name: autoreconf
methods.description: Runs autoreconf in a specified directory, cleaning up and setting up build environment.

methods.name: patch_libtool
methods.description: Patches libtool scripts based on version.

methods.name: gettext_version_target
methods.description: Checks gettext version and updates configure.ac accordingly.
